svg.title: AIcoach — Upload on the phone (r3-03)
svg.text: Upload on the phone, one thing per screen
At the range, one hand free. Every screen opens with the coach’s sentence, and every action sits in the thumb zone.

g.text: From behind, along the target line
On your bag or a tripod
120 fps if your phone has it
Whole body and club in frame
Head to clubhead, the whole swing
mp4 or mov, up to 15 s

svg.text: The six essentials, then one button.

g.text: Off by default. If on, the clip is stored on the AIcoach

svg.text: Clip check. The library opt-in is off by default.

g.text: Got it, a clean clip. Watching
You can put the phone down.

svg.text: Five steps stream in. Key frames pin as they are found.

g.text: I’ve watched it. I found one
fault, and I’m sure of it.
Or ask the coach straight away

svg.text: The four steps as a short contents page.
